source.title: Attempt was found to be misscrambled after a competition (extra not available)
source.content:
*DISCLAIMER: The WCA Regulations and Guidelines relating to misscrambles have been updated since this incident was originally published. The approach described below should no longer be followed from January 1st, 2025.*

After a competition, attempts from several competitors were found to be misscrambled. The WRC investigated each of those attempts to determine if they should stay based on the following criteria:

* If the misscramble gives the competitor a significant advantage, the attempt should be changed to DNF.
* If the misscramble is similar in difficulty to the original scramble, the attempt should be left as is.
* If the misscramble cannot be analyzed (e.g. the video of the attempt is not available), the attempt should be left as is.

Please note that in case the misscramble is found during a competition, it must always be replaced with an extra attempt (see the Incident Log entry [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/86)).

translation.title: 赛后发现错误打乱（无额外尝试）
translation.content:
说明：本事件最初公布后，WCA 关于错误打乱的规则和指南已更新。自 2025 年 1 月 1 日起，不应再采用下述方式。

赛后发现，多名选手的部分尝试使用了错误打乱。WRC 按以下标准逐次调查是否保留：
- 错误打乱带来显著优势：改为 DNF；
- 与原打乱难度相近：保留原成绩；
- 无法分析错误打乱，例如无视频：保留原成绩。

请注意，若在比赛期间发现错误打乱，必须以额外尝试替代（见[日志](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/86)）。
